name: Layout and drawing of Cosmos styles in Rust
body: crates/chaos-ui lays out the bridge's node snapshot: stacks (row/column), gap, padding, margin, align-items, justify-content, width/height/min/max in px, %, vw and vh, flex-grow, position absolute/fixed with offsets, opacity. Draws backgrounds, gradients, borders, rounded corners and text into the overlay. Text uses the engine's 8x8 bitmap font, so font-size becomes a whole-number scale and font-family is ignored.

comments.text: Done 2026-10-30. layout.rs (flexbox subset, px/%/vw/vh, absolute and fixed) and draw.rs (rounded boxes, borders, gradients, shadows, opacity, z-index, bitmap text). Property list in docs/game-api.md.
